g.text: 100 nF from VCC to GND; pin 1 NC
Power the modem before the controller to avoid UART back-powering.
02 Relay drivers and low-voltage test load
Build this circuit twice. K1 uses D1 / GPIO5; K2 uses D2 / GPIO4.
These are bare 5 V relay coils (70-100 mA). Active-low relay modules need different wiring and firmware.

g.text: GPIO HIGH turns the coil ON; LOW and reset turn it OFF.
Do not power a coil directly from a NodeMCU GPIO.
For a mains motor, use an electrician-installed contactor and overload protection.
